candidates.statement: The total space of any family of abelian subvarieties of f J is isotropic. The generalized Hodge conjecture says that ν(B) is actually contained in ν(A0( f X / f M)), but this is not known. candidates.statement: Let D = D(X /M) be the relative Deligne group of a com- plete family of CY threefolds, let eD = D( f X / f M) be the relative Deligne group of the gauged family, and let J , f J be the corresponding relative Jaco- bians. Then there is a natural contact structure κ on D with symplectiﬁcation σ = dτ on eD with the following properties: (a) σ, τ and κ restrict to the previously constructed structures on f J and J . (b) The ﬁbration eD →f M is Lagrangian. (c) All normal functions ν(A( f X / f M)) are integral manifolds for τ (hence isotropic for σ), and normal functions ν(A(X /M)) are integral mani- folds for κ.

candidates.statement: On a generic CY, algebraic equivalence of 1-cycles implies AJ-equivalence; in other words, the Abel-Jacobi map is constant on any connected family of 1-cycles.
candidates.proof_excerpt: The AJ image of the family is isotropic, by Theorem 5, and dominates f M, hence it is Lagrangian and meets the generic ﬁber discretely, so the AJ map is locally constant on the connected family, hence constant.
